name: MonkeyWorkout: Gym Planner
subtitle: Gym plans, AI Coach and Watch
promotionalText: New: show Coach a photo of any machine or meal, and pick how much app you want. Just workouts, a plan, or everything. Your gym week, built around your machines.
description: MonkeyWorkout plans your gym week around the machines your gym really has, runs every session set by set, and has a Coach you can just ask. As much app as you want: just workouts, a plan, or everything.
YOUR WEEK, PLANNED
• A plan from your goal, your days and your gym's machines
• Follow the whole plan, some days, one workout at a time, or only your own workouts
• Your sports stay in the week: climbing, running, padel, swimming and more
• Away, sick or short on time? Move, skip or shorten a day and the week adapts
• Auto-tune reads your sleep, heart-rate variability and recent load to set today's weights
A PLAYER THAT STAYS OUT OF THE WAY
• One screen per exercise: weight, reps, rest and what's next, no scrolling
• Log a set in one tap; the next weight comes from your history
• 3D position guide for every exercise, setup saved per machine
• Supersets, HIIT, EMOM, AMRAP, Tabata and boxing rounds
• Form check with the camera, on device, nothing recorded
• Cast the workout to your TV with Chromecast or AirPlay
ASK COACH
• Ask anything about your training, by voice or text, even mid-set
• Coach does it for you: log water, food, mood or supplements, move or skip a day, swap an exercise, set a reminder, with Undo on every step
• Show Coach a photo of a machine or a meal and get one clear tip
• Coach Monkey explains today's plan and reviews your week
APPLE WATCH
• Start, log and finish on the wrist, live with your iPhone
• Heart rate, rep counting, swims, climbs and sports into Apple Health
• Smart Stack, complications, double tap and the Action button
INSIGHTS, MIND AND FUEL
• Strength, volume and estimated 1-rep max for every lift, a muscle map of your week
• Mind: a daily mood check-in, guided breathing and a Mind score next to your Body score
• Fuel: water, meals, protein, supplements, meal plans and a grocery list you can share with a partner
• Scan food live with the camera
SOCIAL
• Share workouts, records and levels as stories; copy a friend's workout in one tap
• Weekly challenges, levels and badges
PRIVACY

No ads, no tracking, your data is never sold. AI features (Anthropic) ask first and get only what each one needs, never your name or email, and are not used to train models. Delete your account and all its data from the app at any time.

MonkeyWorkout Pro unlocks Ask Coach, Generate and do today, gym scan and food scan. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://workout.monkeygrade.cloud/terms
Privacy Policy: https://workout.monkeygrade.cloud/privacy

notes: Sign in with the demo account below (email + password) or with Sign in with Apple. The demo account has a gym, a weekly plan, past workouts and Pro access, and its app level is set to Everything.
Try a workout: Train tab > Start > tap SET 1 DONE > X (top right) > Finish.

Ask Coach: Train tab > Coach tile, or the Ask Coach button on any screen. The first AI use shows a consent sheet; nothing goes to the AI provider before you agree. Try "I had 2 glasses of water" (logs it, with Undo) or the camera button to send a photo of a machine.
Apple Watch: install the Watch app, then start from the Watch or from iPhone (Start on Watch).
Form check: Explore > any exercise > Check my form. The camera image is processed on the device only; nothing is recorded or uploaded.
Cast to TV: in a workout, the TV button at the top (Chromecast or AirPlay); optional, needs a TV on the same Wi-Fi.
Account deletion: Settings > Account > Delete account (also revokes Sign in with Apple).

AI: Ask Coach, Coach's week review, Talk to Coach mid-set, plan setup, meal ideas, gym and food scans send only the data each needs to Anthropic (Claude), without name, email or account id. Settings > Account > AI & privacy has a switch per feature. Listed in the privacy policy, section AI features.
Community: report and block on every post and profile; text and photos are filtered; posts are hidden after 3 reports.
Subscriptions: MonkeyWorkout Pro (weekly, monthly, yearly with a 1-week trial, lifetime). The paywall shows price, period, Restore, Terms and Privacy links.
